# Jungle Rent

> Real estate startup with dual mission: solving the student housing crisis and democratizing access to real estate investment in Turin, Italy.

## About

Jungle Rent S.r.l. is a certified **Start-up Innovativa** founded in October 2025. We acquire, renovate, and manage properties to rent to university students and tourists in Turin, serving 90,000+ students across 7 major institutions. Investment opportunities start from €100.

## MCP Server (Model Context Protocol)

AI agents can programmatically query Jungle Rent data via MCP:
- **Endpoint**: https://ekrrrlrwdshhlqnuxjbz.supabase.co/functions/v1/mcp-server
- **Tools**: search_articles, get_neighborhoods, get_company_info, get_faq, get_events, get_rent_prices (38 zones), property_valuation (OMI/FIAIP coefficients), get_investment_data (13 zones with yield/vacancy/urban renewal), **contact_jungle_rent** (send email on behalf of user)
- **Protocol**: MCP over HTTP (Streamable HTTP Transport)
- **Auth**: None required (public endpoint)
